compiled_prompt: Plasticine stop-motion two-shot in a cosy clay lighthouse kitchen. On the left a tall lanky clay lighthouse keeper with a drooping ginger moustache, round wire glasses and an oversized yellow raincoat; on the right a short round clay terrier standing upright in a knitted green hat and tiny red scarf. They face each other at eye level. The keeper stares at the porthole and says in a slow deadpan English voice: "The tide is late. Again." The terrier jumps onto the table, knocks the teaspoon, and answers in a quick high voice: "Maybe the sea is on holiday!" The keeper carefully picks up the teaspoon with two fingers and puts it back: "Seas do not take holidays." The terrier points both paws at the door: "Then we go tell it!" Keeper sighs; terrier bounces toward the door. Slightly stepped stop-motion, gentle camera push-in, warm lamp light. Audio: clear turn-taking voices, ticking clock, teaspoon clink, soft ukulele sting.
